card.name: Inside non-Latin script words in parentheses
card.fires_on: Pieces partway through words written in Lao, Greek, Cyrillic or other non-Latin scripts. These usually appear as a foreign-language gloss or motto in an encyclopedia-style passage.

modes.label: Lao script
modes.description: Syllables inside a Lao-script motto in the Laos emblem text.

modes.label: Greek and Cyrillic
modes.description: Pieces inside a Greek or Russian word given as a name or translation.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of foreign-alphabet words, such as Lao, Greek or Russian names given in brackets.
